labels: Small broken tooth-like shapes repeat in contrasting colors across the cloth, with angular stepped edges rather than plain square checks.; 대비색의 작은 이빨 같은 꺾인 모양이 천에 반복되고 단순 사각 체크와 다른 각진 계단형 끝을 갖는다.
definition: Complete optional school-life visual realization: Small broken tooth-like shapes repeat in contrasting colors across the cloth, with angular stepped edges rather than plain square checks.
aliases: 하운드투스의 꺾인 반복
